Date October 1, 19 37

REPORT

Subject (in full) Broadcasting of Lectures bearing on the September 18th
Anniversary.

Made by J.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by C Crawford J.J.

The Broadcasting Station of the Grand Hotel, which was
on 11/9/37
loaned to the Shanghai Amusement Circles National Salvation
Association at the request of the Bureau of Social Affairs
for use in national salvation propaganda, was returned to the
management of the Grand Hotel, Yu Ya Ching Road, on October
1, 1937. The operation of the station will be suspended for
the time being pending overhauling.

Sih Tse liang
C. D. I.

D. C. (Crime & Special Branches).

REPORT    Dated September 18, 1937.
Subject: ____
Made by ____ and Forwarded by C. Crawford

Mr. Liu Chun-shan (刘春山), a comedian of repute, who is a member of the Shanghai Amusement Circles National Salvation Association (上海遊藝界救亡協會), was interviewed in the office of the Chinese Theatrical Players' Society (中国遊藝协会), 206, Avenue Edward VII, in the afternoon of September 17, and informed that the broadcast arranged for September 18 by the Shanghai Amusement Circles National Salvation Association would not be allowed if propaganda was heard in the speech; and the station would be closed down indefinitely. In reply Mr. Liu stated that the broadcasting of certain articles bearing on the occasion was agreed upon only because of the request of one named Chang Yui Lian (张榆良), who is connected with the China Aviation Society, but under the circumstances Mr. Liu said he would withdraw his permission for the broadcast and would not allow it.

C. Crawford
D. I.
（印：COMMISSIONER 18 SEP. 1937 (C) (H)）

著名滑稽演员、上海游艺界救亡协会（上海遊藝界救亡協會）会员刘春山先生（刘春山），于9月17日下午在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）206号中国游艺协会（中国遊藝协会）办公室接受问询，并被告知，如果上海游艺界救亡协会安排的9月18日广播中出现宣传言论，将不予许可；且该电台将被无限期关闭。作为回应，刘先生表示，同意广播某些关于此次纪念活动的文章，仅是因为一位名叫张榆良（张榆良）的人的请求，此人与中国航空社有关联，但在目前情况下，刘先生表示他将撤回对广播的许可，并不允许进行广播。

C. Crawford
D. I.

REPORT
Date September 17, 19 37.
Subject Broadcasting of Lectures bearing on the September 18th Anniversary.
Made by C.D.I. Sih Tee-liang Forwarded by [此处为手写签名，难以辨认]

In commemorating the 6th anniversary of the September 18th
Incident, the Shanghai Amusement Circles National Salvation
Association (上海遊藝界救亡協會), which was organized on
July 28, 1937 and is at present located in the offices of the
Chinese Theatrical Players' Society (中國遊藝協會), Lane 880,
House No. 5, Avenue Edward VII (Chengtu Road district), has
arranged to broadcast lectures, bearing on the anniversary,
between 11 a.m. and 11.40 a.m. daily for one week commencing
from September 18, 1937, through the radio station installed
on the premises of the Society.
According to the programme the speakers in this campaign
will be the seven leaders of the national salvation movement,
who were recently released from Soochow. It has been decided
that the speaker for the first day, September 18, will be
Mr. So Chien-li (沙千里), a lawyer by profession, and one
of the seven. No further arrangements have been made
regarding the other six speakers for the remaining days on
the programme as some of the national salvationists released
from Soochow are absent from Shanghai.
With reference to the radio broadcasting station located
on the premises of the Society, it has been ascertained that
this station actually belongs to the Grand Hotel, Yu Ya Ching
Road (K.C. 1020: Radio Call XHHG; Meter 100.). Following the

[左侧边缘有圆形印章及手写日期：47/SEP 1937] the Grand Hotel received a notice from the Bureau of Social

be loaned to the Shanghai Amusement Circles National Salvation

为纪念九一八事变六周年，成立于1937年7月28日、目前位于爱多亚路（成都路区）880弄5号中国游艺协会（中國遊藝協會）办公室内的上海游艺界救亡协会（上海遊藝界救亡協會），已安排自1937年9月18日起的一周内，每天上午11时至11时40分，通过安装在该协会场所内的广播电台，广播关于该纪念日的演讲。
根据节目安排，此次活动的演讲者将是最近从苏州获释的七位救亡运动领袖。已决定第一天的演讲者，即9月18日，将由律师职业的沙千里先生（沙千里）担任，他是七人之一。由于部分从苏州获释的救亡人士不在上海，节目中其余六天的其他六位演讲者尚未作出进一步安排。
关于位于该协会场所内的无线广播电台，经查实，该电台实际上属于亚尔培路（Yu Ya Ching Road）的大华饭店（K.C. 1020：无线电呼号 XHHG；波长100米。）。继1937年8月上海中日敌对行动爆发后，该电台停止了运作。
1937年9月初，大华饭店管理层 [左侧边缘有圆形印章及手写日期：47/SEP 1937] 收到社会局的通知，指示其无线广播电台借给上海游艺界救亡协会

Eastern Times and other local newspapers :- 18.9.37 A.M)

FURTHER PATRIOTIC PLAYS TO BE STAGED

With a view to raising funds for the relief
of its members who have been rendered destitute since the
outbreak of the present hostilities in this locality, the
Shanghai Municipality Entertainers' National Extinction
Aversion Association will stage plays in the Grand Hotel
Story-Telling Hall ( **〔此处转录不清〕** ) commencing from September 21.
The price of the admission tickets will be $0.50 and $0.30,
and the plays to be performed will be aimed at arousing the
people to defend their country.

旨在为自本地当前敌对行动爆发以来陷入贫困的会员筹集救济资金，上海市政艺人抗亡协会（Shanghai Municipality Entertainers' National Extinction Aversion Association）将于9月21日起在大华饭店说书厅（ **〔此处转录不清〕** ）上演剧目。入场券价格为0.50元和0.30元，演出的剧目旨在唤起民众保卫国家。

REPORT
Date Sept. 21, 19 37.
Subject Grand Hotel Story-Telling Hall : Stage plays advertised to take place.
Made **〔此处转录不清〕** and Forwarded by D.S.I. Logan.

At 9.30 a.m. September 21, 1937, Mr. Chen Hang Chung
(陳翰青), licensee of the Grand Hotel Story-Telling Hall,
Yu Ya Ching Road, accompanied by Mr. Chang Yah Er (張亞耳 )
of the Yah Er ( 亞耳 ) Dramatic Group (producer of the play
entitled "Notorious Traitor" 名劇漢奸) called at Headquarters,
and were informed that the stage play entitled "Notorious
Traitor" would not be permitted. They both agreed to cancel
it. It has been arranged that another comical play entitled
"Foong Yee Ding" (鳳儀亭 ) will be performed on September 23,
1937. This play has been examined and found to contain nothing
objectionable.

Mr. Chen stated that plays will be performed twice
daily for ten days, beginning on 21.9.37. The proceeds will
be donated for the relief of the members of the Shanghai
Municipality Entertainers' National Extinction Aversion
Association.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Louza Police Station,
REPORT
Date Sept. 20, 19 37.
Subject An Attraction.
Made by and Forwarded by Officer i/c Louza. C.I.

Sir,

With reference to the attached I beg to report having interviewed the licensee of the Grand Hotel Story Telling & Sing Song Hall, Yu Ya Ching Road at 5 p.m. 20-9-37.

The situation and reasons for the Police objections were explained to Mr Chen Han Chuing, the licensee and he agreed that the play mentioned might be deemed objectionable and also added that it had been put forward by Shanghai Entertainers Association as it had been already censored on a previous occasion. He further stated that the play would be entirely withdrawn and another put up in its place and that the synopsis of the new play would be sent down to the Special Branch by 2 p.m. 21-9-37. Mr. Chen went on to say that these plays were being put on so as to raise funds in order to alleviate distress amongst the local actors and actresses.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
J McFarlane C.I.
Officer i/c Louza.

D.O. "A" Div.
A.C. Special Branch.

Subject Grand Hotel Story-Telling Hall : Stage plays advertised to take place.

Made XXX and ........................................ Forwarded by ........ D.S.I. Logan,

Reference the attached translation of extract from
September 18th issue of the Eastern Times and other local
Chinese newspapers, a letter was received on 19.9.37, at Police
Headquarters, from the Drama Office of the Grand Hotel Story-
Telling Hall and Shanghai Municipality Entertainers' National
Extinction Aversion Association, containing synopses of plays
which the above Association proposes to stage at the Grand Hotel
Story-Telling Hall on September 21st, 22nd and 23rd with a view
to raising funds for the relief of its members who have been
rendered destitute since the outbreak of Sino-Japanese
hostilities.

Enquiries at Louza Station ascertained that the Grand
Hotel is in possession of a Sing Song and Story Tellers Licence
and therefore is not entitled to stage plays where scenery is
used (though in the past instances have occurred where permission
has been granted to places similarly licensed to stage plays
with only one piece of scenery, and others where, owing to their
inability to pay for a higher licence, the matter has been
（印：RECEIVED M... 20 SEP. 1937 ...）tacitly overlooked). Perusal of the synopses of the plays
scheduled to take place on September 21st and 22nd failed to
reveal anything of an objectionable nature, the plays being in
Shanghai dialect and known as "Shanghai Tai Wan" (上海本地灘簧).

Exception is, however, taken to the play entitled
"Notorious Traitor" (老牌漢奸) which is scheduled to be staged
on September 23rd.

This play is adapted from a well known Chinese
historical play entitled "Tiao Zeu" (釣金龜) and is to be
produced by the Yah Er (亞兒) Dramatic Group. Perusal of the
synopsis, translation of which is given hereunder, will show

由 XXX 和 ____ 制作，经 ____ 副督察 Logan 转呈，

参考附件中摘自9月18日《字林西报》及其他本地中文报纸的译文摘录，警察总部于1937年9月19日收到来自大华饭店说书厅戏剧办公室和上海市政艺人抗亡协会的信件，其中包含该协会拟于9月21日、22日和23日在大华饭店说书厅上演的剧目剧情概要，旨在为自中日敌对行动爆发以来陷入贫困的会员筹集救济资金。

经向老闸捕房查询，证实大华饭店持有说唱执照，因此无权上演使用布景的舞台剧（尽管过去曾有过类似持牌场所获准上演仅使用一件布景的剧目，以及其他因无力支付更高额执照费用而被默许忽略的情况）。查阅定于9月21日和22日上演的剧目概要，未发现任何不当性质，这些剧目使用上海方言，被称为“上海本地滩簧”（Shanghai Tai Wan）。

然而，对于定于9月23日上演的名为“老牌汉奸”（Notorious Traitor）的剧目提出异议。

该剧改编自一部著名的中国传统戏曲“钓金龟”（Tiao Zeu），将由亚儿（Yah Er）戏剧团制作。查阅剧情概要（其译文如下所示）将显示

that the play, which is of the comic variety, offers excellent
opportunity for pointed innuendo which might easily be turned
into anti-Japanese propaganda, and which, having regard to the
name of the Association under whose auspices the plays are to
be staged, may well be presumed to be intended to be of an anti-

is impromptu and an exact copy of the dialogue cannot be

        Having regard to the conditions at present prevailing,
it is respectfully suggested that it is undesirable to allow
any plays produced by the aforesaid Association to be staged
in the Settlement.    Inspector i/c of Louza was communicated
with by the undersigned and acquainted with the foregoing.

        Synopsis of stage play entitled "Notorious Traitor"
is as follows :-

        "During the Han Dynasty, Tung Tsao (? Minister) who was
"very influential at that time intended to take over the empire.
"He had a very brave general named Li Poo associating with him.
"All the faithful officials opposed his ambition but none of
"them could do anything. On seeing the situation, one named
"Sz Doo Wong Ying at first betrothed his beautiful maidenservant
"Tiao Zeu to General Li Poo, and later had the girl married to
"Tung Tsao. As a result, General Li Poo killed Tung Tsao, thus
"saving the Han Dynasty from being ruined."

        The part which is considered objectionable and which
is to be sung on stage by the entire body of the group, is
as follows :-

"Rise, all comrades,
"Take the responsibility of reviving the Han Empire.

该剧属于喜剧类，提供了绝佳的含蓄影射机会，极易被转化为反日宣传；且鉴于演出该剧的协会名称，有充分理由推定其意图具有反日性质。此外，在此类剧目中，许多对白为即兴发挥，无法向警方提供确切的对白文本。

        鉴于目前 prevailing 的局势，谨建议不允许上述协会制作的任何剧目在租界内上演。下文签署人已与老闸捕房负责督察取得联系，并告知上述情况。

        题为《著名汉奸》的舞台剧剧情梗概如下：-

        “汉代时期，当时权势极大的董卓（?大臣）意图篡夺帝国政权。
        “他手下有一位名为吕布的勇猛将军与之勾结。
        “所有忠臣都反对他的野心，但均无能为力。目睹此情势，一位名为司徒王允的人起初将其美丽的婢女貂蝉许配给吕布将军，随后又将该女子嫁给董卓。结果，吕布将军杀死了董卓，从而挽救了汉朝免于覆灭。”

        被认为具有冒犯性、并将由剧团全体成员在台上演唱的部分如下：-

“同胞们，起来，
“承担起复兴汉室的责任。
